ambiguities: "le roi Swann VI" is a whimsical fictional card-game king invoked only for a visual comparison with the stained-glass figure; it is a playful naming device, not an appearance of the character Swann, so no event was scored.

"une dame de Guermantes dont il était amoureux" is part of a legendary tradition about the tapestry's Esther/Assuérus figures and refers to a generic, unnamed ancestral lady of the Guermantes family, not clearly the duchesse de Guermantes as a present character, so it was not scored.

le narrateur and le père du narrateur appear only as perceiving/describing presences (attending mass, recognizing the bell tower) with no staged social interaction or evaluative outcome, so neither was scored.
